svg.title: ech-errand: read-only errands in the main thread, the errand-router hook and code-explorer
svg.desc: The main thread runs read-only Bash and Read calls. The PreToolUse hook errand-router classifies each call with a regex and counts errands in a row; a user prompt, another tool or a non-errand call resets the run. The 1st and 2nd are only counted. From the 3rd it nudges toward the Haiku code-explorer; in block mode, and in an enforce project, the 5th and later are denied. Half the sessions are a silent control group. code-explorer returns file:line only, and its result opens a verify window of 8 errands that are never nudged. Every call adds one ledger line. Jev is opt-in and off by default.
svg.text: green: tool call · amber: nudge or result back · white: ledger line · dashed: off by default
A walk-through of the rule with five errands in a row, not measured data. A subagent's calls are never routed.
